subject: SI Quickstart: Technical Track & Enablement Sprint for Meridian Analytics
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@meridian.ai>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SI Quickstart: Technical Track & Enablement Sprint for Meridian Analytics

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. As discussed, we'd like to propose a focused "SI Quickstart" (3-week engagement) to accelerate your Meridian team and the systems integrator you've selected through technical enablement, runbook handoff, and a short pilot integration. The goal is to make your consultants independently deploy and validate a Redwood inference pipeline against your sample workload.

Attached: meridian-siq-milestones.xlsx (high-level sprint milestones) and technical-runbook-v1.pdf (draft runbook with infra and integration checklist).

High-level plan (technical track):
- Week 0 (prep): credentials, network access, SSO/KMS requirements, and dataset pointers.
- Week 1 (integration): connector validation, model selection run, and latency profiling.
- Week 2 (validation + runbook transfer): end-to-end test, canary policy setup, and operator training.

We can staff a Redwood technical lead + two enablement engineers. Internal owners: Aisha (enablement lead) and Camila (solutions lead) are looped.

Please confirm: preferred kickoff week (options: Jan 23, Jan 30, Feb 6), and whether Meridian procurement needs an SOW before scheduling. Also share a short list of the SI contacts who will attend the hands-on sessions.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: meridian-siq-milestones.xlsx, technical-runbook-v1.pdf

From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@meridian.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Torres <ben.torres@meridian.ai>, procurement@meridian.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 11:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SI Quickstart: Technical Track & Enablement Sprint for Meridian Analytics

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear plan. Jan 30 works best for our engineering calendar (gives us two weeks to prep). We'll have two Meridian integration engineers (Ben & Priya) and our SI partner Crescent Systems will send a lead (TBD).

Procurement note: yes, we need an SOW and preliminary pricing to get an internal PO started. Can you share a draft SOW and ballpark cost? Also attaching our internal resource list for visibility.

Thanks —
Sofia
Head of Data Platforms
Meridian Analytics

Attachment: meridian-internal-resource-list.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@meridian.ai>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SI Quickstart: Technical Track & Enablement Sprint for Meridian Analytics

Sofia —

Great — locking Jan 30 as the kickoff week. Well circulate a draft SOW by EOD Thursday. Ballpark pricing for the 3-week technical track (Redwood staff + enablement materials + follow-up support): USD 45k - 60k depending on whether you choose on-premise access vs VPC private deployment. We'll mark line items in the SOW for optional add-ons (extended training days, extra operator seats).

Quick mutual-action plan (draft):
- By Jan 13: SOW draft from Redwood (DocuSign-ready) — Karthik/Aisha
- By Jan 18: Meridian completes access checklist and confirms SI lead(s) — Sofia/Ben
- Jan 30: Kickoff (day 0 prep call) — all
- Week 1: Integration lab sessions (hands-on) — Redwood engineers + SI
- Week 2: Validation + runbook handoff + final report — Redwood + Meridian

Operational ask: we need your SOC 2 contact and any vendor questionnaire templates Meridian requires. Ava, can you link our standard vendor packet and the SOW template here for Sofia?

On the attachments: including the milestone workbook and runbook as the starting point. We will also prepare a technical runbook that the SI can operationalize (playbooks for deployment, KV cache tuning, and autoscale policies).

Thanks,
Karthik

On Wed, Jan 11, 2028 at 08:15 AM Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@meridian.ai> wrote:
> Karthik —
>
> Jan 30 works for us. Procurement wants the SOW and pricing first — happy to proceed once we have a draft.
>
> Sofia

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SI Quickstart: Technical Track & Enablement Sprint for Meridian Analytics

Hi Sofia / Karthik —

Thanks — SOW draft is attached (sow-draft.docx) and I've created a DocuSign envelope so procurement can preview terms. DocuSign: https://redwood.app/docusign/RW-SOW-4492

Team notes:
- Trainers: Aisha (lead), Camila (solutions), plus one enablement engineer (Ava).
- Curriculum highlights: connector mapping, load/latency profiling, canary routing policies, and operator runbook exercises.
- Deliverables: runbook (operator + infra), test plan, and a short "lift" report documenting cost/latency tradeoffs.

Sofia, attaching our standard vendor packet with SOC 2 contact info. Let me know if Meridian has any additional security constraints (e.g., HSM-only keying, VPC peering windows).

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Enablement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sow-draft.docx

From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@meridian.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Torres <ben.torres@meridian.ai>, procurement@meridian.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SI Quickstart: Technical Track & Enablement Sprint for Meridian Analytics

Karthik / Aisha —

Thanks — we reviewed the SOW and the DocuSign link works. Procurement will route the SOW for an internal PO; should have an answer by Jan 20. Our SI partner (Crescent Systems) confirmed their lead: Victor Chen (victor.chen@crescentsys.com) will join the kickoff and the hands-on labs.

Two quick asks before kickoff: 1) can you add a short section in the runbook about our expected token billing visibility and how Redwoods per-route cost breakdown maps to our billing exports? 2) will the training include a short troubleshooting checklist for KV cache corruption and common operator errors?

Agree Jan 30 kickoff — please send calendar invite once the PO is underway. Looking forward to working together.

Best,
Sofia Alvarez
Head of Data Platforms
Meridian Analytics
